utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the fifth, first one of 2026. Can you all hear me?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, just about. Had Teams coming through the wrong speaker again.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Did anyone's weekend plans survive that weather? Mine mostly became sitting indoors watching it rain.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Went for a walk. Fairly quickly became a walk back to the car.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Sounds familiar. My plans for next weekend now depend entirely on whether my coat dries.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: On a brighter note, there's a birthday cake in the office. Already there, before anyone thinks I'm offering to bake.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Is that the one in the massive tin?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah. Tin's mostly cake, not mostly packaging for once.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: A rare bit of good news for a Monday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we turn this into a cake meeting. Finished bits first?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the cooling tower yesterday and it's all fine now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's finished, then, not something rolling into this morning?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Finished. Nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I tested the GT1 Compressor Section yesterday and it's all fine now as well. Both done.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Nice to have those off the list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One observation from nights: noticed the water booster was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Settled before the end of nights, you mean?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. Just passing on what was seen, not raising another job out of it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're on status, I still can't get to the air dryer until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's still blocked. Not calling that an agreed job for today.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly. No window, no access. That's where it sits.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line one HPU. Same blocker as before.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, that delivery's still unconfirmed, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Blocker noted, no fresh action on that in this meeting. Actual jobs now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you inspect the GT1 fuel valve for leaks by the 28th? Whenever you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll inspect the GT1 fuel valve for leaks by the 28th. Fit it in whenever I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just to be clear, that's a routine inspection request, not someone reporting an active leak?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, no active leak being reported here. It's the inspection we're agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Understood. That's mine, with the 28th as the deadline.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right. Plenty on these lists ends up sounding like it's all top priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, and it isn't. Same distinction on the conveyor.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, can you grease and check the bearings on the Main Outfeed Conveyor? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Grease and check the bearings, yeah? Not just a grease round.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it, both. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, I'll grease and check the bearings on the Main Outfeed Conveyor. I've got that.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, greasing something and knowing the bearing's all right aren't quite the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Mm, exactly. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you run a function test on the line 2 interlock? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah. Separate from the two tests I mentioned earlier, obviously.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, those are closed. This is a separate function test on the line 2 now being put on the list.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine, I'll run a function test on the line 2 interlock. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's a useful distinction. Not an emergency doesn't mean forgotten about.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, agreed. It's on mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you chase the purchase order for the CV01 today at 2pm? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit. Today at 2pm for the chase?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, today at 2pm. It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Got you. I'll chase the purchase order for the CV01 today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And that's separate from the delivery confirmation I was on about?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. I'm taking the purchase order chase for the CV01, not another supplier chase for the blocked delivery.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the line one at half two. That's fairly important as well.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you there—you're taking both the permit to work and the isolation?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, both. I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the line one at half two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. Agreed, that's yours. Fairly important, as you say.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And just so the two conversations don't get mixed up, that's not me saying production's given us access to the air dryer.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, definitely not. That one's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Aisha, just confirming those two times: purchase order chase for the CV01 today at 2pm; permit to work and isolation for the line one at half two.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, agreed. Both with me, and both fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good. The cake, for the avoidance of doubt, has no purchase order attached.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That'll be why it actually arrived.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ha. Right, we've got the agreements and the blocked bits are still blocked. Thanks, everyone.
